name: Collier Eleonora
ligne: Autour du cabochon ovale d’Eleonora, en serti clos, s’étend un large pavage de diamants.
description: Collier Eleonora, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, serti d’un saphir taille cabochon et pavé de diamants ronds. Pierre de centre aussi proposée en diamant noir, émeraude ou rubis.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰
Serti d’un saphir taille cabochon et pavé de diamants ronds

en.ligne: A broad pavé of diamonds spreads around Eleonora’s oval cabochon in its rub-over setting.
en.description: Eleonora necklace in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, set with a cabochon sapphire and pavé-set round diamonds. Centre stone also available in black diamond, emerald or ruby.

it.ligne: Attorno al cabochon ovale di Eleonora, a castone, si estende un ampio pavé di diamanti.
it.description: Collana Eleonora in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, con uno zaffiro cabochon e pavé di diamanti rotondi. Pietra centrale disponibile anche in diamante nero, smeraldo o rubino.
